{{Quote|Here we go, if we're going to make a tactical withdrawl, sir, it's now or never.''"<br />"''Anyone for ''now''?''"<br />"''Not really, sir.|Attie and Clone Captain CT-7567 during the Battle of Teth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Attie''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who was part of the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Attie served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] and later the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], where he assisted General Skywalker and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], in recovering a kidnapped [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]]. He scaled the cliff wall and defended against a second [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] force, liberating himself from his droid captors along with his comrades. He was one of only six clone troopers to survive the mission.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
As a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Attie stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was born on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Attie first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|Star Wars: The Clone Wars film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
